Private Const TAX_RATE_DEFAULT As Double = 0.08

' ---- Function GetTierDiscount ----
Public Function GetTierDiscount(ByVal tier As CustomerTier) As Double
    Select Case tier
        Case tierSilver
            GetTierDiscount = 0.05
        Case tierGold
            GetTierDiscount = 0.1
        Case tierPlatinum
            GetTierDiscount = 0.15
        Case Else
            GetTierDiscount = 0
    End Select
End Function

' ---- Function GetVolumeDiscount ----
Public Function GetVolumeDiscount(ByVal qty As Long) As Double
    If qty >= 100 Then
        GetVolumeDiscount = 0.12
    ElseIf qty >= 50 Then
        GetVolumeDiscount = 0.08
    ElseIf qty >= 10 Then
        GetVolumeDiscount = 0.03
    Else
        GetVolumeDiscount = 0
    End If
End Function

' ---- Function GetTaxRate ----
Public Function GetTaxRate(ByVal region As String) As Double
    Select Case UCase$(Trim$(region))
        Case "CA"
            GetTaxRate = 0.0725
        Case "NY"
            GetTaxRate = 0.08875
        Case "NJ"
            GetTaxRate = 0.06625
        Case "TX"
            GetTaxRate = 0.0625
        Case "OR", "MT", "NH", "DE"
            GetTaxRate = 0
        Case Else
            GetTaxRate = TAX_RATE_DEFAULT
    End Select
End Function

' ---- Function CalculateLineTotal ----
Public Function CalculateLineTotal(ByRef line As OrderLine, ByVal tier As CustomerTier) As Double
    Dim gross As Double
    Dim discountRate As Double

    gross = line.Quantity * line.UnitPrice
    discountRate = GetTierDiscount(tier) + GetVolumeDiscount(line.Quantity)
    If discountRate > MAX_TOTAL_DISCOUNT Then discountRate = MAX_TOTAL_DISCOUNT

    ' VBA Round uses banker's rounding (round half to even)
    CalculateLineTotal = Round(gross * (1 - discountRate), 2)
End Function

' ---- Function CalculateShipping ----
Public Function CalculateShipping(ByVal subtotal As Double, ByVal weightKg As Double, _
                                  ByVal expressShipping As Boolean) As Double
    Dim cost As Double

    If subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD And Not expressShipping Then
        CalculateShipping = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    If weightKg <= 1 Then
        cost = 4.99
    ElseIf weightKg <= 5 Then
        cost = 9.99
    ElseIf weightKg <= 20 Then
        cost = 19.99
    Else
        cost = 19.99 + (weightKg - 20) * 0.75
    End If

    If expressShipping Then cost = cost * 2
    CalculateShipping = Round(cost, 2)
End Function

' ---- Function ApplyPromoCode ----
Private Function ApplyPromoCode(ByVal subtotal As Double, ByVal promoCode As String) As Double
    Select Case UCase$(Trim$(promoCode))
        Case "WELCOME10"
            ApplyPromoCode = subtotal * 0.9
        Case "SAVE20"
            If subtotal >= 200 Then
                ApplyPromoCode = subtotal - 20
            Else
                ApplyPromoCode = subtotal
            End If
        Case ""
            ApplyPromoCode = subtotal
        Case Else
            ApplyPromoCode = subtotal
    End Select
End Function

' ---- Function CalculateOrderTotal ----
Public Function CalculateOrderTotal(ByRef lines() As OrderLine, ByVal tier As CustomerTier, _
                                    ByVal region As String, ByVal weightKg As Double, _
                                    ByVal expressShipping As Boolean, _
                                    Optional ByVal promoCode As String = "") As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim subtotal As Double
    Dim shipping As Double
    Dim tax As Double

    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        subtotal = subtotal + CalculateLineTotal(lines(i), tier)
    Next i

    subtotal = Round(ApplyPromoCode(subtotal, promoCode), 2)
    shipping = CalculateShipping(subtotal, weightKg, expressShipping)
    tax = Round(subtotal * GetTaxRate(region), 2)

    CalculateOrderTotal = subtotal + shipping + tax
End Function

' ---- Function NeedsReorder ----
Public Function NeedsReorder(ByVal onHand As Long, ByVal reorderPoint As Long, _
                             ByVal leadTimeDays As Long, ByVal avgDailyUsage As Double) As Boolean
    Dim projected As Double
    projected = onHand - (leadTimeDays * avgDailyUsage)
    NeedsReorder = (onHand <= reorderPoint) Or (projected <= 0)
End Function

' ---- Function SuggestedOrderQty ----
Public Function SuggestedOrderQty(ByVal onHand As Long, ByVal leadTimeDays As Long, _
                                  ByVal avgDailyUsage As Double, ByVal packSize As Long) As Long
    Dim target As Double
    Dim needed As Double
    Dim packs As Long

    If packSize <= 0 Then packSize = 1
    target = avgDailyUsage * (leadTimeDays + SAFETY_DAYS)
    needed = target - onHand
    If needed <= 0 Then
        SuggestedOrderQty = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    packs = Int(needed / packSize)
    If packs * packSize < needed Then packs = packs + 1
    SuggestedOrderQty = packs * packSize
End Function

' ---- Function ClassifyAbc ----
Public Function ClassifyAbc(ByVal annualValue As Double, ByVal totalValue As Double) As String
    Dim share As Double
    If totalValue <= 0 Then
        ClassifyAbc = "C"
        Exit Function
    End If
    share = annualValue / totalValue
    If share >= 0.2 Then
        ClassifyAbc = "A"
    ElseIf share >= 0.05 Then
        ClassifyAbc = "B"
    Else
        ClassifyAbc = "C"
    End If
End Function

' ---- Function SafeDivide ----
Public Function SafeDivide(ByVal numerator As Double, ByVal denominator As Double) As Double
    On Error GoTo Handler
    SafeDivide = numerator / denominator
    Exit Function
Handler:
    SafeDivide = 0
End Function

' ---- Function SumPositive ----
Public Function SumPositive(ByRef values() As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim total As Double
    For i = LBound(values) To UBound(values)
        If values(i) > 0 Then total = total + values(i)
    Next i
    SumPositive = total
End Function

' ---- Function DaysOfStock ----
Public Function DaysOfStock(ByVal onHand As Long, ByVal avgDailyUsage As Double) As Long
    Dim days As Long
    If avgDailyUsage <= 0 Then
        DaysOfStock = 9999
        Exit Function
    End If
    Do While onHand > 0 And days < 9999
        onHand = onHand - CLng(avgDailyUsage + 0.5)
        days = days + 1
        If onHand <= 0 Then Exit Do
    Loop
    DaysOfStock = days
End Function

' ---- Function MonthlyPayment ----
Public Function MonthlyPayment(ByVal principal As Double, ByVal annualRatePct As Double, _
                               ByVal years As Long) As Double
    Dim r As Double
    Dim n As Long

    n = years * 12
    If n <= 0 Then
        MonthlyPayment = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    r = annualRatePct / 100 / 12
    If r = 0 Then
        MonthlyPayment = Round(principal / n, 2)
    Else
        MonthlyPayment = Round(principal * r / (1 - (1 + r) ^ (-n)), 2)
    End If
End Function

' ---- Function TotalInterest ----
Public Function TotalInterest(ByVal principal As Double, ByVal annualRatePct As Double, _
                              ByVal years As Long) As Double
    TotalInterest = Round(MonthlyPayment(principal, annualRatePct, years) * years * 12 - principal, 2)
End Function

' ---- Function BuildAmortization ----
Public Function BuildAmortization(ByVal principal As Double, ByVal annualRatePct As Double, _
                                  ByVal years As Long) As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim payment As Double
    Dim balance As Double
    Dim interest As Double
    Dim schedule() As Double

    n = years * 12
    payment = MonthlyPayment(principal, annualRatePct, years)
    balance = principal
    ReDim schedule(1 To n, 1 To 4)

    For i = 1 To n
        interest = Round(balance * annualRatePct / 100 / 12, 2)
        If i = n Then payment = balance + interest   ' final payment clears the balance
        schedule(i, 1) = i
        schedule(i, 2) = interest
        schedule(i, 3) = payment - interest
        balance = Round(balance - (payment - interest), 2)
        schedule(i, 4) = balance
    Next i
    BuildAmortization = schedule
End Function

' ---- Function NetPresentValue ----
Public Function NetPresentValue(ByVal ratePct As Double, ByRef cashFlows() As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim npv As Double
    For i = LBound(cashFlows) To UBound(cashFlows)
        npv = npv + cashFlows(i) / (1 + ratePct / 100) ^ (i - LBound(cashFlows))
    Next i
    NetPresentValue = Round(npv, 2)
End Function

' ---- Function NormalizeSku ----
Public Function NormalizeSku(ByVal rawSku As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    s = UCase$(Trim$(rawSku))
    s = Replace(s, " ", "-")
    s = Replace(s, "_", "-")
    If Len(s) > 12 Then s = Left$(s, 12)
    NormalizeSku = s
End Function

' ---- Function IsValidEmail ----
Public Function IsValidEmail(ByVal email As String) As Boolean
    Dim atPos As Long
    Dim dotPos As Long
    email = Trim$(email)
    atPos = InStr(email, "@")
    If atPos < 2 Then Exit Function
    If InStr(atPos + 1, email, "@") > 0 Then Exit Function
    dotPos = InStrRev(email, ".")
    IsValidEmail = (dotPos > atPos + 1) And (dotPos < Len(email))
End Function

' ---- Function ToTitleCase ----
Public Function ToTitleCase(ByVal text As String) As String
    Dim words() As String
    Dim i As Long
    words = Split(LCase$(Trim$(text)), " ")
    For i = LBound(words) To UBound(words)
        If Len(words(i)) > 0 Then
            words(i) = UCase$(Left$(words(i), 1)) & Mid$(words(i), 2)
        End If
    Next i
    ToTitleCase = Join(words, " ")
End Function

' ---- Function IsValidLuhn ----
Public Function IsValidLuhn(ByVal digits As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    Dim d As Long
    Dim total As Long
    Dim doubleIt As Boolean

    digits = Replace(digits, " ", "")
    If Len(digits) < 2 Then Exit Function
    For i = Len(digits) To 1 Step -1
        If Mid$(digits, i, 1) < "0" Or Mid$(digits, i, 1) > "9" Then Exit Function
        d = CLng(Mid$(digits, i, 1))
        If doubleIt Then
            d = d * 2
            If d > 9 Then d = d - 9
        End If
        total = total + d
        doubleIt = Not doubleIt
    Next i
    IsValidLuhn = (total Mod 10 = 0)
End Function

' ---- Sub BuildOrderSummary ----
Public Sub BuildOrderSummary()
    Dim wsOrders As Worksheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim r As Long
    Dim outRow As Long
    Dim lines(0 To 0) As OrderLine
    Dim tier As CustomerTier
    Dim orderTotal As Double
    Dim grandTotal As Double
    Dim skipped As Long

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Set wsOrders = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Orders")
    Set wsSummary = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Summary")

    wsSummary.Cells.ClearContents
    wsSummary.Range("A1:D1").Value = Array("OrderId", "Sku", "Region", "Total")
    outRow = 2
    lastRow = wsOrders.Cells(wsOrders.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    For r = 2 To lastRow
        If Not IsNumeric(wsOrders.Cells(r, 5).Value) Or wsOrders.Cells(r, 5).Value <= 0 Then
            skipped = skipped + 1
        Else
            lines(0).Sku = NormalizeSku(CStr(wsOrders.Cells(r, 4).Value))
            lines(0).Quantity = CLng(wsOrders.Cells(r, 5).Value)
            lines(0).UnitPrice = CDbl(wsOrders.Cells(r, 6).Value)
            tier = ParseTier(CStr(wsOrders.Cells(r, 2).Value))

            orderTotal = CalculateOrderTotal(lines, tier, CStr(wsOrders.Cells(r, 3).Value), _
                         CDbl(wsOrders.Cells(r, 7).Value), CBool(wsOrders.Cells(r, 8).Value), _
                         CStr(wsOrders.Cells(r, 9).Value))

            wsSummary.Cells(outRow, 1).Value = wsOrders.Cells(r, 1).Value
            wsSummary.Cells(outRow, 2).Value = lines(0).Sku
            wsSummary.Cells(outRow, 3).Value = UCase$(CStr(wsOrders.Cells(r, 3).Value))
            wsSummary.Cells(outRow, 4).Value = orderTotal
            grandTotal = grandTotal + orderTotal
            outRow = outRow + 1
        End If
    Next r

    wsSummary.Cells(outRow + 1, 3).Value = "Grand total"
    wsSummary.Cells(outRow + 1, 4).Value = grandTotal
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Processed " & (outRow - 2) & " orders, skipped " & skipped & ".", vbInformation
End Sub

' ---- Function ParseTier ----
Private Function ParseTier(ByVal text As String) As CustomerTier
    Select Case LCase$(Trim$(text))
        Case "silver": ParseTier = tierSilver
        Case "gold": ParseTier = tierGold
        Case "platinum": ParseTier = tierPlatinum
        Case Else: ParseTier = tierStandard
    End Select
End Function
